title: The Biggest Order Block Myth Costing Traders Funded Accounts in 2026
description: Everyone marks order blocks wrong. Here's the truth the R2F Trading system has used for 10+ years to pass funded accounts consistently. Stop trading random candles — learn what a real order block actually is.
